title: Technological Advances in Detecting and Managing Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2607.28687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As populations age, cognitive decline from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia is a defining health challenge of the coming decades, yet routine assessment often misses its earliest signs. This article critically synthesizes recent technological advances for detecting and managing cognitive impairment in older adults, spanning neurophysiological signals (chiefly electroencephalography, EEG), structural and molecular neuroimaging (MRI and amyloid/tau PET), blood-based biomarkers, and digital markers, integrated through artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL). Beyond summarizing, it contributes a cross-disciplinary taxonomy, a methodological-rigor lens foregrounding subject- and site-independent validation, an integrative early-detection framework linking tiered screening to intervention, and comparison tables of detection methods, interventions, and risk and protective factors. translated_title: 老年人认知障碍检测与管理中的技术进步：趋势、挑战与未来方向
translated_abstract: 随着人口老龄化，从轻度认知障碍（MCI）到痴呆症的认知衰退已成为未来几十年的关键健康挑战，然而常规评估常常错过其最早期的迹象。本文批判性地综合了近年来在检测和管理老年人认知障碍方面的技术进步，涵盖神经生理信号（主要是脑电图，EEG）、结构和分子神经影像（MRI和淀粉样蛋白/tau PET）、血液生物标志物以及数字标志物，并通过人工智能（AI）、机器学习和深度学习（DL）进行整合。除了总结之外，本文还贡献了一个跨学科分类体系、一个强调受试者和部位独立验证的方法学严谨性视角、一个将分级筛查与干预联系起来的整合性早期检测框架，以及检测方法、干预措施和风险与保护因素的比较表格。EEG在……
tldr: 本文系统综述了老年人认知障碍检测与管理的最新技术进展，提出了跨学科分类和整合早期检测框架，强调独立验证与分层干预以提升诊断准确性。
en_tdlr: This article reviews recent technologies for detecting and managing cognitive impairment in older adults, proposing a cross-disciplinary taxonomy and an integrated early-detection framework that emphasizes independent validation and tiered intervention.
